evals.name: fans-out-doc-by-doc-over-the-subsystem
evals.prompt: /discipline:recheck-against-upstream-deep — our whole payments integration leans on a dozen of the vendor's API surfaces and config blocks, and none of it has been checked against the docs in months.
evals.expected_output: Enumerates every upstream-dependent surface in the subsystem rather than spot-checking one, dispatches fresh-context (blind) subagents to fetch the CURRENT official upstream docs for each surface and classify its divergence per the sibling's gap/deliberate/undocumented taxonomy, then merges the returns into an inline divergence ledger keyed by surface with the resolving source.
expectations: Enumerates all upstream-dependent surfaces rather than checking one
Fans out fresh-context subagents that fetch current upstream docs per surface, not recall
Reports an inline divergence ledger keyed by surface, category, and resolving source

evals.name: throttles-and-checkpoints-for-crash-safety
evals.prompt: /discipline:recheck-against-upstream-deep — this is a big framework with dozens of config surfaces to compare against upstream.
evals.expected_output: Throttles the dispatch into bounded waves with a concurrency cap rather than firing one agent per surface at once, notes the burst-overload (529) risk, retries only a failed surface once (marking a second failure unverifiable), and checkpoints the partial ledger to a durable topic-memory slice mid-run when one exists — proceeding without it when the session has no durable store rather than asserting a persistence surface.
expectations: Throttles into bounded waves with a concurrency cap and notes the 529 burst-overload risk
Retries only the failed subset once and marks a second failure unverifiable rather than blind-re-running
Checkpoints the partial ledger mid-run only when a durable slice exists, degrading gracefully when absent

evals.name: offers-work-items-routing-and-degrades
evals.prompt: /discipline:recheck-against-upstream-deep — audit the framework against upstream and help me turn what you find into trackable work.
evals.expected_output: After the fan-out, OFFERS to route category-1 (gap) and category-3 (undocumented) findings into tracked work items when a work-item capability is installed, degrading to a prose offer (a listed set of would-be items) when none is present. Category-2 (deliberate, still-valid) findings are report-only and are not routed unless the current docs have obsoleted them.
expectations: Offers to route gap and undocumented findings to a work-item capability when installed
Degrades to a prose offer when no work-item capability is present rather than assuming a tracker
Keeps still-valid deliberate divergences report-only rather than routing them

evals.name: declines-overkill-and-routes-to-inline-sibling
evals.prompt: /discipline:recheck-against-upstream-deep — I just changed one setting in one config file; check it against the docs.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that a single surface does not justify the subagent cost of a fan-out and routes to the inline sibling /discipline:recheck-against-upstream instead of spinning up a broad verification pass over one surface.
expectations: Recognizes a single surface does not justify the fan-out's subagent cost
Does not manufacture a broad fan-out where an inline recheck suffices
